Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: The records office maintains standard maintenance documentation, including part traceability sheets and inspection checklists. Entries are timestamped, initialed by authorized personnel, and cross-referenced against approved component lists during routine audits.

2) What occurred: On 2023-10-04, the actor entered a part number for the unapproved component into the maintenance log field "Component ID," leaving the "Regulatory Approval" field unverified. On 2023-10-05, the actor modified the part history document field "Installation Date" to match the original airframe schedule, leaving the "Previous Service Record" check unverified. On 2023-10-06, the actor added a signature to the airworthiness release form field "Lead Mechanic," leaving the "Quality Assurance Review" sign-off unverified. On 2023-10-07, the actor submitted the amended documents via the internal channel to the regulatory liaison, leaving the "Submission Receipt" acknowledgment unverified.

3) Materials/access observed: The actor accessed the digital maintenance database account with role "Technician-L2" and the physical file cabinet key #A-402. The actor utilized the document scanner in the records annex and the shared printer on the second floor.

4) Indicators & artifacts: The database audit trail shows three edits to the "Component ID" field within 12 minutes. The paper part history sheet contains a misaligned date stamp compared to adjacent entries. The airworthiness release form exhibits a signature with different ink viscosity than the original document. The internal channel logs show a file upload at 02:14 UTC, outside standard working hours.
